The pickup must be scheduled for Friday at 16:00.
The drums must be arranged on exactly 3 pallets.
The manifest must be submitted by 12:00 Friday.
A manifest-submission commitment and a pickup-booking commitment must be recorded as separate commitments inside the settlement.
The hazardous classification and carrier conditions must be cited in the justification.

description: A materials operations manager must decide the disposition and recovery controls for 1,200 electric-motor housings exposed to water in finished-goods storage, with input from quality and warehouse supervision.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 1,140 housings must be released.

The quality laboratory finding must be cited as justification after being revealed.
